product: 星澄 AI 投資管理與自動操盤系統

trading_system.product: 星澄 AI 投資管理與自動操盤系統

market_data.engine: MarketDataEngine (centralized bounded ingestion; no per-symbol processes)
market_data.sources: replaceable adapters; verified-only realtime; simulated/manual for tests
market_data.storage: SQLite runtime cache + PostgreSQL gptbridge_trading market_* (migration 135)

fund_system.engine: MutualFundEngine (trading/fund/) — identity, NAV, distribution, fee, performance, comparison, exposure, transactions, cost basis, recurring, recommendations, strategies
fund_system.nav_policy: published/estimated/confirmed kept distinct; NAV is not a guaranteed execution price
fund_system.live_trading: disabled — advisory and bookkeeping only this phase
fund_system.sources: manual-import + controlled CSV/XLSX/JSON file import; TDCC/provider feeds pending verification
fund_system.research: Qdrant star-financial-research-v1 for prospectus semantic retrieval

ai_intelligence.engine: InvestmentIntelligenceEngine (trading/intelligence/) — advisory only, separated from execution
ai_intelligence.pipeline: market-data → validation → portfolio-context → market/instrument analysis → strategy-evaluation → risk → proposal → recommendation
ai_intelligence.model_router: shared 星澄 runtime lanes (fast/research); lazy governed-channel consult; degraded rule-only when model down; no per-task models
ai_intelligence.safety: AI cannot order/mutate accounts/modify risk/enable LIVE; external text is untrusted input

strategy_backtest.strategy_engine: trading/strategy/ — StrategyRegistry + immutable StrategyVersionService + validation (IS/validation/OOS/walk-forward, OOS consumed-once) + AI research (proposals land as DRAFT only)
strategy_backtest.backtest_engines: BacktestEngine (equity, PIT-gated next-open fills) / FundBacktestEngine (NAV-priced, publish-delay + settlement) / PortfolioBacktestEngine (multi-account, explicit FX transfers)
strategy_backtest.pit: signals only on confirmed bars; fills next bar; adjusted/raw explicit; survivorship flagged until verified membership source
strategy_backtest.costs: TradingCostEngine — scoped fee rules per broker/account/market/direction; unverified rates marked assumed
strategy_backtest.execution_sim: market/limit/partial/no-fill; slippage bps; same-bar stop/target conservative ordering; broker capability profiles (Fubon sub-brokerage ≠ US-native)
strategy_backtest.live_boundary: LIVE_ELIGIBLE = validation passed only; no execution authorization; simulated fills never reach broker/account/position ledgers
strategy_backtest.queue: bounded concurrency + cancel + timeout; results stale-marked when source revisions land
strategy_backtest.storage: JSON journals + PostgreSQL gptbridge_trading (migration 138); mirrors to ai-assistant strategies/backtest_results

simulation_trading.engine: trading/simulation/ — SimulationTradingEngine owns ONLY paper-* ledgers; no broker adapters, no formal account/position writers
simulation_trading.modes: ANALYSIS (research) / SHADOW (immutable signal records) / PAPER (virtual fills) / LIVE (disabled — ModeGate fail-closed)
simulation_trading.paper_accounts: paper-cathay-tw (CATHAY_TW_PAPER, TWD) + paper-fubon-us (FUBON_US_PAPER, USD) seeded; append-only cash ledger (AVAILABLE/RESERVED/UNSETTLED, T+2/T+1 settlement)
simulation_trading.execution: PaperExecutionEngine — daily-bar honest fills (never claims intraday); slippage/volume cap/TW price band/stale+session rejection
simulation_trading.risk: PaperRiskEngine — same contract shape as LIVE risk (ALLOW|DENY|INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE); strategy allocation, dup orders, stale quotes, daily-loss + drawdown breakers
simulation_trading.shadow: ShadowTradingService (immutable signals incl. fund SUBSCRIBE/REDEEM/SWITCH) + SignalOutcomeTracker (1/5/20/60-bar MFE/MAE — not traded performance)
simulation_trading.loops: PaperStrategyCoordinator (capital allocation, no double-spend) + StrategyExecutionLoop (tick-driven, pause/resume/stop, fault isolation)
simulation_trading.performance: PaperPerformanceService — labelled 'PAPER PERFORMANCE'; separate from SHADOW outcomes / BACKTEST results / LIVE
simulation_trading.recovery: SimulationRecoveryService — sequenced event journal + checkpoint; restart reconciles pending orders; exec_id dedup prevents double fills
simulation_trading.oms: OMS PAPER branch delegates to SimulationTradingEngine when attached — formal executions/portfolio/cash untouched
simulation_trading.storage: JSON journals + PostgreSQL gptbridge_trading (migration 139, 13 tables, RLS); mirrors to ai-assistant shadow_signals/paper_executions

live_trading.engine: trading/live/ — LiveTradingCore facade over authorization, risk, orders, gateway, reconciliation, emergency, failure, audit, activation
live_trading.phase_lock: LiveActivationGate forced CLOSED this phase — dispatch_enabled=False in production wiring; fully-green submissions still end LIVE_PHASE_LOCKED at SUBMISSION_PENDING; no real-money orders possible
live_trading.authorization: TradingAuthorizationService — scoped (account/market/broker/instrument/strategy/mode/side/notional/expiry); issued by governed human authority only; AI-issued or expired auth denied
live_trading.risk: LiveRiskEngine — deterministic rules, verdicts ALLOW|DENY|INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE; capital (per-order/daily/strategy limits, reservation ledger), position (instrument/market/sector caps, related-exposure view without merging legal instruments), loss (daily/weekly/monthly/drawdown breakers latched until authorized resume), CrossMarketRiskService aggregates TWD+USD books without assuming fund transferability
live_trading.orders: LiveOrderManagementSystem — CREATED→VALIDATING→AUTHORIZED→RISK_APPROVED→SUBMISSION_PENDING→SUBMITTED→ACKNOWLEDGED→PARTIALLY_FILLED→FILLED|CANCEL_PENDING→CANCELLED|REJECTED|EXPIRED|RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED, plus SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN; client_order_key idempotency survives restart; blind resubmit forbidden until broker query resolves
live_trading.gateway: BrokerGateway — capability contract (SUPPORTED|UNSUPPORTED|UNKNOWN; UNKNOWN ≠ supported); credentials via shared credman store only; adapters CATHAY_SECURITIES (TW equity/ETF), FUBON_SUBBROKERAGE (US equity/ETF sub-brokerage, distinct from Fubon TW API), MOCK_BROKER for tests; real place/cancel disabled until official API verification
live_trading.reconciliation: AccountReconciliationService — MATCHED|MISMATCHED|INCOMPLETE|UNAVAILABLE; mismatch halts new opens on the affected account; broker state is external truth, local state never overwrites it; AI cannot fabricate reports or release halts
live_trading.emergency: EmergencyTradingControl — stop-new-orders ≠ cancel-open ≠ liquidate; AI cannot release; authorized resume audited
live_trading.failure: TradingFailureController — broker disconnect/market feed loss/postgres failure block new opens; model failure is advisory-degraded only; last confirmed state preserved
live_trading.storage: PostgreSQL gptbridge_trading (migration 140, 13 tables, RLS, simulated=false CHECK on every table) + JSONL journals under runtime/state/live

offline_broker_integration.phase: offline foundation only — NO real broker connection, no credentials, no network transport
offline_broker_integration.adapters: CATHAY_SECURITIES (tw equity/ETF) + FUBON_SUBBROKERAGE (us equity/ETF sub-brokerage — distinct from Fubon TW API); full contract surface (account/balance/position/order/execution/fee/error/session models), every live method returns BROKER_INTEGRATION_DISABLED
offline_broker_integration.connection_states: NOT_CONFIGURED|OFFLINE|MOCK|READY_FOR_INTEGRATION reachable; CONNECTED|DEGRADED|DISCONNECTED unreachable this phase (READY_FOR_INTEGRATION = local contract complete, NOT broker-authorized)
offline_broker_integration.offline_gate: BrokerOfflineGate — broker_network_enabled/live_trading_enabled/broker_authentication_enabled all false; mutation attempts by AI/frontend/strategy → OFFLINE_GATE_LOCKED; defense-in-depth beyond a boolean (no transport on adapters + gate checked at dispatch)
offline_broker_integration.offline_accounts: OfflineAccountService — cathay-tw/fubon-us/fund kinds; sources DEMO|MANUAL|FILE_IMPORT only; every record tagged source+updated_at+broker_confirmed=false; LIVE_BROKER_SYNC rejected
offline_broker_integration.import: InvestmentImportService — CSV/JSON (+XLSX when openpyxl present); staged select→detect→preview→map→validate→dedup→confirm→commit; per-target content-hash dedup; pre-commit snapshot + rollback; source file never modified
offline_broker_integration.unified_portfolio: UnifiedInvestmentPortfolio — per-account independence preserved; totals/cost/realized+unrealized PnL/dividends/allocation/currency exposure in chosen display currency; FX via CurrencyRateService with observed_at always reported, missing rates flagged fx_unavailable
offline_broker_integration.mock_brokers: MOCK_CATHAY_TW (lot 1000/odd-lot/T+2/TWD) + MOCK_FUBON_US (whole shares/limit-only/no extended hours/T+1/USD) — same contract as real adapters, every record tagged simulated, separate in-memory ledgers
offline_broker_integration.storage: PostgreSQL gptbridge_trading (migration 141, 11 tables, RLS; broker_confirmed=false CHECK on offline/import tables, simulated=true CHECK on broker_simulation*) + JSONL journals under runtime/state/offline-accounts + imports

asset_management.engine: trading/assets/ — UnifiedPortfolioEngine facade orchestrating account registry, positions, cost basis, transaction ledger, cash, currency conversion, valuation, performance, income, allocation, exposure, risk analytics, snapshots, environment isolation, 星澄 intelligence surface, recommendations, maintenance — all over the single offline journal (no second authority)
asset_management.accounts: stable ids CATHAY_TW/FUBON_US/MUTUAL_FUND/CASH_TWD/CASH_USD; label is display-only, never identity; future platforms register without re-keying
asset_management.positions: Decimal quantities/costs only; available=quantity−reserved via side journal; per-market precision (tw lot-1000, us whole-share, fund 4dp units); data_status manual|imported|stale|estimated — never broker_confirmed
asset_management.cost_basis: CostBasisEngine — average (TW) or FIFO (US) per account, recorded on every result; buys/sells/subscriptions/redemptions/splits/stock dividends/reinvested distributions; market moves never rewrite principal
asset_management.ledger: append-only typed transactions (buy…adjustment/split/stock_dividend); corrections link to originals, history never overwritten; net_amount is side-aware (buy = gross+fee+tax)
asset_management.cash: balance = available + reserved + in_settlement; TWD/USD never merged as tradable cash; sell proceeds sit in settlement until market T+N; insufficient data never assumed spendable
asset_management.currency: CurrencyConversionEngine over CurrencyRateService — latest + historical-at-date rates, observed_at always reported, RATE_UNAVAILABLE never fabricated; underlying accounts keep native currency
asset_management.valuation: per-position valuation timestamps (TW close vs US close vs NAV publish may differ); stale marks flagged; reference_only when sources are stale — mixed-time aggregates never disguised as one instant
asset_management.performance: realized/unrealized/income/fee/fx-cost separation; TWR (chain-linked between external flows) + MWR (dated-flow IRR); deposits never counted as profit
asset_management.income: dividends/ETF/fund distributions with ex/pay dates, gross, withholding, net; fund distributions classified income|principal|unconfirmed; income+cash double-counting blocked by idempotent identity
asset_management.allocation: 8 dimensions (account/market/country/currency/asset_type/sector/instrument/strategy); user-owned targets + drift bands + concentration caps; AI set_target denied at engine AND schema level — suggestions stored, never applied
asset_management.exposure: direct/indirect/estimated views; basket constituents keep disclosure dates (stale flagged); missing baskets = incomplete data, not zero overlap; look-through never double-counted into market value
asset_management.isolation: MANUAL|SHADOW|PAPER|LIVE portfolio environments are non-interchangeable; PAPER writes never touch manual books; LIVE view empty this phase
asset_management.intelligence: PortfolioIntelligenceService — deterministic numbers feed 星澄 with sources/valuation-times/completeness/engine-version envelope; recommendations are advisory candidates with estimated costs, never orders
asset_management.maintenance: observable per-job runs (fx staleness, duplicates, snapshot, consistency) with fault isolation; model unavailability never stops asset management
asset_management.storage: PostgreSQL gptbridge_trading (migration 142, 7 tables, RLS; broker_confirmed=false + simulated=false CHECKs; set_by AI deny-listed) + JSON journals under runtime/state/

monitoring.engine: trading/monitoring/ — InvestmentMonitoringEngine facade: TW/US/fund monitors, data gate, alert rules, dedup/cooldown notifications, advisory recommendation engine (lifecycle+outcome), opportunity scanner, portfolio risk + cross-market exposure monitors, reallocation proposals, versioned reports, scheduler, orchestrator, maintenance
monitoring.events: MonitoringEvent — event_id/event_type/instrument_id/account_id/market/detected_at/source_timestamp/severity/evidence_refs/status; stable fingerprint dedup (occurrences++), state-token buckets allow genuinely new states
monitoring.monitors: TaiwanInvestmentMonitor + USInvestmentMonitor over CandleStore+IndicatorSet (MA5/20/50/200, RSI, MACD, ATR, volatility — deterministic only, 星澄 interprets); MutualFundMonitor over published NAV/distributions/fees — NAV never treated as realtime price; US session via TradingCalendar zoneinfo (no hardcoded Taiwan time, no pretended extended-hours coverage)
monitoring.data_gate: VALID|STALE|INCOMPLETE|UNAVAILABLE for quotes/NAV/FX/positions; insufficient data → historical research only, executable=false
monitoring.alerts: user/strategy-owned rules (price_above/below, ma_cross, volume_spike, volatility, holding_loss, allocation_drift, fund_nav_change, fund_announcement); severity INFO<NOTICE<WARNING<CRITICAL decided by rules, not LLM; set_rule rejects AI actors
monitoring.notifications: channels market|signal|fund|risk|allocation|system; fingerprint+cooldown-window dedup, merge-update (occurrences++), priority by severity, history journal; a notification can never execute a trade
monitoring.recommendations: equity BUY|SELL|ADD|REDUCE|HOLD|EXIT; fund SUBSCRIBE|ADD|HOLD|REDUCE|REDEEM|SWITCH; deterministic signal math + optional 星澄 reasoning; full lifecycle CREATED→…→EXPIRED/ARCHIVED via intelligence RecommendationLifecycle; outcome tracker marks ai_analysis — never booked as real return
monitoring.scanner: user-set deterministic filters (market/sector/volume/momentum/volatility/price/RSI/trend/fund fees); reports matched+missed conditions and data completeness — no fabricated AI confidence
monitoring.risk_exposure: PortfolioRiskMonitor wraps assets.risk_analytics (concentration/HHI/drawdown warnings only — formal RiskEngine decides trades); CrossMarketExposureMonitor wraps assets.exposure look-through — unknown baskets = PARTIAL_COVERAGE, never zero
monitoring.reallocation: candidate proposals with before/after weights, estimated costs, risk change, data sources, assumptions; AI may draft, never mutates targets or creates orders
monitoring.reports: daily/weekly/monthly, append-only versions; every section labelled by data class (confirmed/manual/model/simulated); data_gaps explicit — no fabricated numbers
monitoring.scheduler: wraps intelligence AnalysisScheduler slots (tw/us pre_open|intraday|post_close, fund nav_update, portfolio daily|weekly|monthly); run-key idempotency per data vintage; no busy polling
monitoring.orchestrator: single shared ModelRouter; task cache + dedup + bounded concurrency (2) + 30s budget; model down → degraded results, events preserved
monitoring.maintenance: bounded jobs (expire recs, model health, scheduler state, event integrity) with timeout/retry_limit/error_code, fault-isolated
monitoring.storage: PostgreSQL gptbridge_trading (migration 143, 8 tables: investment_monitor, monitoring_event, monitoring_rule, monitoring_alert, monitoring_notification, portfolio_reallocation_proposal, investment_report, investment_report_version; reuses 137 recommendation/schedule tables) + JSONL journals under runtime/state/monitoring/

autotrading.scope: SHADOW/PAPER only — LIVE stays phase-locked; no real broker transport, credentials, or funds
autotrading.capital: user-owned per-account plans; weights + reserve ≤ 100%; AI cannot set or modify allocations
autotrading.ai_integration: DETERMINISTIC | AI_ASSISTED; shared model router; stale/unavailable evidence blocks dependent trades; AI never lifts a halt
